title: Liquid collection, sludge removal and emergency transfer in plate alkaline-cleaning equipment
summary: Basket transfer between alkali pots, residue removal inside a pot and emergency liquid transfer after a leak are three different tasks. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s alkaline-cleaning section proposal dated 4 May 2024 separately provides inter-pot drip trays, a liftable false bottom and a mobile emergency-transfer device. For a similar project, place basket movement, lid opening, cleaning and transfer equipment on the same layout and allocate their space and supporting services individually.
